subject: June reliability heat-check + OKR anchors (lead review)
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Julie Dudley <julie.dudley@acme.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: June reliability heat-check + OKR anchors (lead review)

Team —

Attaching a short packet that stitches together the operational facts from the June 22 partial-region degradation impacting Acme AI, the current OKR cadence, and the credit request that CS has prepared. High-level items for the lead review: 

- Incident recap (timeline + root cause hypothesis): kernel OOM during a model variant rollout in us-west that triggered degraded autoscaler behavior. Containment took 3h; customer impact window ~45m. See attachment incident_timeline_acme_20270622.pdf.
- Metrics: p50 latency +8% month-over-month; error rate spike to 1.9% for affected routes; cache miss rate during the window +12 pts.
- Customer asks: Acme requests a one-time credit and confirmation of changes to rollout checks. Julie is looped in.
- OKR implications: we are at risk of missing Reliability Objective #2 (reduce region P1s to <1/quarter) unless we formalize the rollout gates and add a canary KCI for kernel memory signals.

Asks for leads before EOD Wed:
1) Sign off on the proposed short-term mitigations (see page 3 of the packet) — owner: Marissa.
2) Agree the OKR anchor change (add rollout gating KCI) so we can call it out in the QBR slides — owner: Hannah.
3) Approve the customer credit recommendation (see credit_request_summary.pdf) so I can finalize the commercial note for procurement — owner: Vivek.

If we agree, I will draft the one-slide exec summary for Thursday's QBR and circulate for a 1-hour run-through Wed 11:00 PT.

Attachments: incident_timeline_acme_20270622.pdf (3 pages), okr_checkpoint_2027Q2.xlsx, credit_request_summary.pdf

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Customer & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: June reliability heat-check + OKR anchors (lead review)

Thanks Vanessa — I reviewed the mitigations and agree with the short-term plan. Specifics:
- Immediate: add a pre-rollout kernel memory check to the pipeline and block rollout on >70% utilization spike.
- Near-term: add a cold-start eviction test in the canary cluster (2 weeks).
- Ops: schedule a tabletop with infra next Tue to validate runbooks (owner: me).

I'll own the communication to CS and finalize patch dates. I also added two small edits to the timeline PDF (clarified when autoscaler backoff engaged).

On the customer credit: I support the recommendation but defer to Vivek on commercial quantum. If we approve, I'll coordinate the DocuSign and the note to procurement.

Marissa
Director, Reliability Programs
Redwood Inference
